# R2.13 — Audit residual: witness cosignatures, receiver receipts, GC/redaction emitter audit

Ticket `docs/tickets/119_R2.13__audit-residual.md`
(seq 119). Stacked on `svitali/harnessharness-r2.12` (PR #119);
ADR-0345. Offline-only: every cell is `fixture`-verified — no
live/staging environment, no production mutation, custody external.

**Requirement ids:** DF-S1.15-3 · DF-S1.15-1 · BL-21 · R-2.8.6.

## What landed

**Witness cosignatures (ADR-0345 D1–D3).**
`RunManifest.witness_policy{required, witnesses[{witness_name,
key_id}]}` declares the quorum durable from seq 0 — additive/optional,
pre-C2 manifests untouched. `checkpoint_witnessed` /
`rotation_checkpoint_witnessed` / `rotation::rotate_witnessed` mint
`witness_cosignatures[{witness_name, key_id, timestamp, sig}]` where
`sig = hmac-sha256(witness_key, timestamp_ms ‖ checkpoint_sig_preimage)`
— the C2SP tlog-cosignature shape over the *same* unsigned note the
primary signer signed (`unsigned_checkpoint` already excludes the
member, so witnessed rotation covers the post-rotation note with no
special case). The mint refuses sub-quorum supply and undeclared
`(witness_name, key_id)` pairs (`SignerUnavailable`), and plain
`checkpoint` refuses under a declared-but-unsatisfiable policy — no
sub-quorum claim ever reaches the durable prefix. Verification runs on
one shared `check_witness_cosignatures` across `verify_run`
(`Tampered{bad_signature}` on HMAC mismatch, `SignerUnavailable` on a
custody gap), `Auditor::check_claim` (policy read from the *durable*
manifest, never caller-supplied), and `audit_view`'s per-checkpoint
`witness_status` (`verified`/`unverified`, never a fabricated pass).
Witness custody stays external exactly like signer custody (OQ-170 —
`NamedSigner`/`KeyTable` are fixture constructions).

**Receiver receipts (ADR-0345 D4).** `lifecycle.ledger.receipt` is a
kernel-origin audit-grade class carrying `{effect_id, observed_ref?,
receiver_ref, receipt_id, attested_at, attestation{key_id, alg_ref,
sig}, status, supplied_by}` + optional `claim_ref` (the claim document
lives blob-side; the row stays content-free). `Store::record_receipt`
lifts the record *as supplied*: `status` is fixed `unverified` by the
codec — `Receipt::from_json` refuses any row claiming otherwise, so no
row can carry a verification claim the kernel did not make (T-LCD-07 —
receiver authority never exceeds `external`). `effect_id` binds to the
run's effect fold (`UnknownEffect`); `observed_ref` must name this
run's `action.effect.observed` row for that effect; `receipt_id` is the
idempotence key (identical re-record returns the existing row;
same-id/different-members refuses). `audit_view` grows a `receipts`
fold reporting each row's `binding_status` (`bound`/`unbound`) +
`completeness.receipts_ok` — accounting, never an upgrade. Post-`final`
receipts are structurally refused (`final` requires `run.finished`;
`emit_system` answers `RunFinished`). The boundary surface is
`lab.receipt.record` — `serves_measurement`-gated, `supplied_by`
kernel-derived from the session holder, `status` not a wire member; a
capability lift over the one `hh-embed/1` boundary, not a
native-contract change (ADR-0067's ruling; T-LCD-06/-07).

**GC/redaction emitter audit (DF-S1.15-1 member).** Call-site sweep:
`Store::gc`/`gc_bounded`/`redact` are the workspace's only blob-
deletion paths (the only `fs::remove_file` on the pool) and each
commits its durable `lifecycle.ledger.gc`/`lifecycle.ledger.redacted`
row *before* bytes leave (R2.2, ADR-0068); `lifecycle.escalation.*`
emitters exist at every machinery site; `security.secret.redacted` has
no runtime call site (pre-existing — noted, not widened). The
composition battery proves the ordering holds alongside the new rows.

**DF/BL dispositions.** DF-S1.15-3 — dated progress: cosignatures +
receipts DONE; **per-event blob encryption stays OPEN** — no conforming
pure-std AEAD mechanism exists and inventing one would fabricate
cryptography (ADR-0345 revisit trigger (a)). DF-S1.15-1 — dated
progress: the gc/redaction emitter coverage is audited closed; still
owed: real signer-key custody (OQ-170), `subagent_anchor`,
`producer_resolution`. BL-21 → closed (see BACKLOG).

## Tests (fail-if-removed)

- `crates/hh-ledger/tests/r2_13.rs` — 11 cells: `witness_policy` codec +
  validation; cosign over the same note verified by hand-recomputed
  HMAC; sub-quorum/undeclared mint refusals (and plain `checkpoint`
  refusing under a declared policy); forged cosig →
  `Tampered{bad_signature}` on `verify_run` + `Auditor`; resolver gap →
  `SignerUnavailable` with the view degrading `unverified`; witnessed
  rotation over the post-rotation note on a rotated corpus + chained
  post-rotation checkpoint; the shared defect vocabulary
  (`Malformed`/`Undeclared`/`KeyUnresolvable`/`QuorumUnmet`); receipt
  lift durable+`unverified`+idempotent+`bound`; typed refusals
  (unknown effect, bad `observed_ref`, malformed shapes — nothing
  durable); a `status:verified` row never parses; gc+redact
  durable-before-delete composed with the new rows (`content_refs.gc`
  accounting).
- `crates/hh-embed/tests/r2_13.rs` — 2 cells: `lab.receipt.record` is a
  typed boundary op (missing members → `SchemaViolation`; unknown
  effect → `Refused`/`UnknownEffect`; malformed attestation →
  `SchemaViolation`; read-only session → `Refused`; no fabricated
  rows); missing `serves_measurement` → `CapabilityNotDeclared`.
